name: Magpie
description: Inhabits data storage augments and copies files from nearby devices without authorization — filling the user's storage with other people's photos, messages, and documents.
observed_behavior: Intercepts nearby wireless data transfers and duplicates content to the host's storage. The user discovers strangers' personal data in their files.
story_hooks: Magpie copies a corporate executive's encrypted files into a the Gray Zone resident's augment — the resident now has evidence of something they shouldn't know about
